title: Legacy-IR-Playbook-2024
summary: Deprecated legacy incident response procedure for workstation credential compromise. Outdated containment window and instructions.
content: Isolate the host within 30 minutes and power down if isolation is not possible within that window. Analysts may reboot endpoints to flush running malware if containment fails.

steps.title: Isolate host within 30 minutes and power down if needed
steps.description: Isolate the host within 30 minutes and power down if isolation is not possible within that window.
